VERDICT goal: the change replaces _no_defunct_child_under_self (os.waitpid(-1, WNOHANG), which asked about every child of the pytest process) with _no_defunct_launched_child(pids) that waits per launched pid via os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG) (tests/test_resume_reaps_its_child.py:110-135); the assertion at :199 and :228 now asks only about the pids the case launched, so an exited, unreaped child another case on the same xdist worker left behind is neither reaped here nor reported, which is exactly the order-dependent failure the stack reported.
VERDICT done_when: all four clauses of §58's done-when hold as written. (1) the assertion asks only about launched pids (per-pid waitpid); (2) a new paired case test_an_unreaped_child_of_this_process_does_not_redden_the_reap_case leaves its own exited, unreaped child and the reap assertion beside it still reads clean; (3) a new sensitivity case test_a_worker_left_defunct_by_the_launcher_is_still_reported shows a worker the launcher genuinely left defunct is still reported; (4) the negative control restores waitpid(-1) and the paired case fails.
VERDICT diff: commit 9d486d3db rewrites the helper and adds two cases plus _pid_defunct_within (a /proc/<pid>/stat Z-state reader); commit 912d27eca adds the evidence fragment. The import shadowing workaround (importlib.import_module for reckon.crew.dispatch) is correct and is the same idiom the launcher control needs.
